short: A saved copy of a machine.
whyItMatters: Four different objects are called this: a restore point, a reusable image, a memory copy, and a backup. Whether memory is included decides whether a restored machine resumes your agent or boots it cold.

meanings.meaning: No snapshot product: a sleep checkpoint (not cloneable), a folder backup, and Dockerfile templates.
Three kinds: stop (disk and memory), continuous (disk, every ten minutes), named (disk, usable as a template).
Memory and disk, named and versioned, boots machines that are already running. Checkpoints are in-place; backups are disk-only.
Disk only; may stop the machine to take it; includes saved logins.
Memory, processes and the whole disk; restores at the source's size.
Memory and disk by default, disk-only on request; cannot snapshot a machine with a volume.
Automatic, disk-only, every minute, newest only; saved snapshots are the named kind.

checkFor: Ask: memory or disk, can it be cloned, can I pick an old one, and where is it stored?
